title: Local finite support for a single section of a restricted free module sheaf
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U and V opens with U contained in V, and I a type in the module universe. Write R for the structure sheaf of rings and O_U for the unit sheaf of R|U-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For a morphism b:O_U -> (O_V^(I))|U and x in U, there are an open neighbourhood W of x contained in U, a finite subset S of I, and a morphism a:O_W -> (O_V^(S))|W whose composite with the restricted basis inclusion into (O_V^(I))|W equals b|W. Only one section is involved, and no finite-rank source, simultaneous choice or epimorphism hypothesis occurs.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BB, first paragraph of the proof, specialized to one section of a free module sheaf; Lemma 01AH (2). https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01BB and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01AH.

proof.text: The diagram of finite subsets S of I viewed as types, with subtype-inclusion transition maps, has colimit I. Define the descent map from a cocone by sending i through the singleton {i}. Naturality for {i} contained in S gives the factorization law, and testing on singleton stages gives uniqueness. Apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.freeFunctor, which preserves colimits and takes inclusions to freeMap, to obtain the colimit cocone of finite free sheaves over V. This is finiteSubsetIsColimit in the delivered module.

For any colimit cocone c of module sheaves over V, form the presheaf colimit P of the underlying diagram. The module sheafification adjunction, its invertible counit, and preservation of colimits by its left adjoint give an isomorphism from the sheafification of P to c.pt. Unit naturality, cocone compatibility, and the triangle identity identify the canonical presheaf comparison k with the unit followed by the underlying isomorphism. Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_toSheafify' proves local surjectivity of this comparison; composition with an isomorphism preserves it. All these claims are proved in the private helper colimit_comparison_locally_surjective; no project theorem about stalks or restriction colimits is needed.

Evaluate b on 1 at the terminal object of Over U, giving a section over U in Over V. The locally surjective comparison has a covering image sieve for this section. Translate the over-site covering sieve into a covering sieve of U with GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff, and choose W containing x. Its lifted presheaf section comes from a stage i by sectionwise preservation of colimits by PresheafOfModules.evaluation and filtered-colimit preservation by the module forgetful functor, followed by Types.jointly_surjective. The chosen element of stage i on W defines a compatible family by restriction from the terminal object of Over W, hence a morphism a via unitHomEquiv. The presheaf-colimit factorization equation and naturality of b identify the value on 1 of a composed with the stage coprojection with that of b restricted to W. Maps from the unit are determined by this value, because all their associated sections are restrictions of the terminal one. Apply this completely proved generic private helper exists_unit_local_colimit_lift to the finite-free colimit cocone of step 1 and rewrite its coprojection using freeFunctor_map. This proves the stated finite-support factorization, including empty I.

proof_origin.place: E2 formalization of the one-section local lifting step in Tag 01BB, first paragraph, using the sheafification description of colimits in Tag 01AH (2) instead of the stalk description. The type-colimit singleton construction and the adjunction comparison are proved explicitly in Lean.

from.place: The finite-generation step of the affine-union construction in the H1 constructible representation: choose a finite support locally near each point before compactness selects a finite subcover. Part: Local finite support for maps with finite free source. Single-basis-image part: finite support of one germ and one local representative.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_unit_local_support
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V U : X.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V) (I : Type u)
    (b : unit ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) ⟶
      (overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hUV)).obj
        (free (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V) I)) (x : U) :
    ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U), (x : X) ∈ W ∧ ∃ (S : Finset I)
      (a : unit ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W) ⟶
        (overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE (hWU.trans hUV))).obj
          (free (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V) S)),
      a ≫ (overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE (hWU.trans hUV))).map
        (freeMap (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V) ((↑) : S → I)) =
      (overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hWU)).map b
